Robin (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the rollback window & acceptance criteria for the onprem VPC upgrade next week. customer pilots start Mon. Who's on call for rollback ops?
Sam (Eng-Platform): I can own the rollback scripts and runbook. question: do we need automated DB schema backwards-compat check?
Priya (SRE): yes please. If a datastore migration is risky we should block auto-rollout. we can run a dry-run validation step in staging and collect metrics.
Jules (CustomerOps): customers asked for a 1-hour planned rollback window where they can opt out of the upgrade. need to confirm commute/maintenance windows too.
Alex (Field SE): for ACME corp, ops team wants packets to remain pinned to existing VIPs during rollback — that impacts our edge routing plan.
Sam (Eng-Platform): noted. rollback plan: 1) disable new routing rules, 2) revert kube manifests for gateway, 3) restore iptables and BGP policies, 4) restart controlplane. should fit ~30-45m in happy-path. script: ```./scripts/rollback-onprem.sh --restore-vip --reapply-old-routing```
Priya (SRE): add a KV cache flush step after rollback so models don't serve stale session tokens. Also need health-check gating: CPU<70% and tail-latency < 300ms on 95th.
Robin (PM): acceptance criteria draft: - successful smoke test (health, token auth, simple inference) within 20m - no customer 5xx spikes for 15m after rollback - routed traffic restored to pre-upgrade VIPs - post-rollback telemetry for 24h collected and shared. comments?
Jules (CustomerOps): can we add a customer notification cadence in case rollback takes >30m? e.g., at 15m and 30m.
Alex (Field SE): +1. and allow field teams to opt into a manual-hold before step 3 for high-risk customers.
Sam (Eng-Platform): to support manual-hold we'll add a "--hold-before-controlplane" flag to the script that creates a pause and waits for manual ack.
Priya (SRE): ops playbook items: runbook link, escalation matrix, and a fast-rollback checklist. I added known failure signatures: BGP flaps, kubelet CRI errors, failing readiness probes.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for onprem-vpc-upgrade @1768888015 — 10% tenants.
Sam (Eng-Platform): seeing an elevated readiness probe failure in canary group 2, pausing rollout. attaching logs: ```kubectl -n redwood get pods | grep gateway```
Priya (SRE): good catch. start rollback dry-run on staging, run smoke again. If staging passes, we can do targeted rollback for canary group 2 only.
Robin (PM): timeline decision: if targeted rollback completes cleanly and metrics stabilize in 40m, continue rollout with updated network config. if not, full rollback and reschedule.
Jules (CustomerOps): I'll prepare customer comms templates for both targeted and full rollback paths.
Alex (Field SE): I'll assemble per-customer VIP mapping and a quick validation script to verify VIP ownership post-rollback.
Sam (Eng-Platform): I'll open PR for `rollback-onprem.sh` with `--hold-before-controlplane` and `--restore-vip` flags and add smoke test hooks.
Priya (SRE): final ask — add a post-rollback regression alert to detect model-quality drift (we've seen regressions after routing changes before).
Robin (PM): agreed. action items: Sam = PR + runbook; Priya = staging dry-run checklist + alerts; Jules = customer comms; Alex = VIP mapping + validation script. will reconvene 1768888095 after canary pause. thanks :thumbsup:
